title: The penalty window collapses on quantum annealing hardware: code and data
description:
Code and data accompanying the manuscript The Penalty Window Collapses on Quantum Annealing Hardware: A Scaling Variable and a Sample-Based Rule for Penalty Weights in Constrained QUBO (J. Cho, M. Lee, I. Kim, D. Lee), submitted to EPJ Quantum Technology.

Contents: emulation sweeps and selection-rule results (data/emulation); D-Wave Advantage QPU raw data, embeddings and QPU-time ledger (data/qpu); derived analyses (data/derived); analysis and QPU scripts (code). README.md lists the command behind each table and figure, and PROVENANCE.md documents the QPU runs.

Licenses: the data are released under CC BY 4.0 (data/LICENSE) and the code under the MIT License (LICENSE).
